name: metis
description: Métis — AI-driven specification and requirements knowledge-graph platform for Quality Engineering. Skills for reviewing quarantined graph entities, checking state machines, onboarding repositories into ingestion, and rendering quality reports, plus the Métis MCP server itself.

plugins.name: metis
plugins.description: Métis skills: review quarantined items with real graph context, check state machines for determinism/completeness/reachability (CONST-048/049), onboard a repository into the ingestion pipeline, and render quality snapshots as a dated deck or an always-current site. Skills route through the bundled metis agent.

plugins.name: metis-mcp
plugins.description: The Métis MCP server: traceability, coverage, impact analysis, quality and release reporting, test-design reporting, two-stage intake mining (Requirement + AcceptanceCriterion derivation from any Episode), and skill discovery. Install alongside the metis plugin to give its skills a live graph to work against.
